gold_product.title: Cora Modern Black Arc Floor Lamp with USB Dimmer - 360 Lighting
gold_product.product_category: Tools & Home Improvement › Lighting & Ceiling Fans › Lamps & Shades › Floor Lamps
gold_product.description: From the 360 Lighting brand, this elegant arc floor lamp with a USB dimmer offers contemporary styling for your home. It features a widely arching frame in a black finish and a white linen drum shade on top, resulting in a sleek modern look. A great upgrade for seating areas and living rooms, this floor lamp is great for reading task lighting. The tabletop dimmer works with dimmable CFL and dimmable LED bulbs, as well as halogen and incandescent bulbs, and it also comes with a built-in USB port, allowing you to easily charge phones and other devices.
bullet_points: 72" high overall. Base is 12 1/2" wide x 2" high. Shade is 15" wide x 8 1/2" high. Weighs 25 lbs.
From the center of the pole to the outside edge of the shade is 50". From the bottom of the shade to the floor is 60".
Uses one maximum 150 watt standard-medium base bulb (not included). On-off foot switch on the cord.
